rubric_hint.rule: 3 site-bound forest NT species recorded within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 1.62 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

Three site-bound forest NT species are recorded within 250 m, all in 2026, which meets the MEDIUM threshold. Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum and Hermanssonia centrifuga are at 0 m (uncertainty 25 m), and Hertelidea botryosa (lichen) is at 153 m. Each has felling-relevant threats such as lack of dead wood or continuity forest.
No threatened (CR/EN/VU) species were found within 250 m, so there is no eligible species at this ring. The NT bird Emberiza citrinella is mobile and only supporting evidence.
Effort is adequate (63 records within 1000 m against a county median of 42). 8 records from 7 species lie inside the polygon, and 30 records from 25 species lie within 250 m, all from a single day.

uncertainties: Near-site records come from one observation day, so they may reflect a single survey visit.
I did not query the 500 m and 1000 m rings. An eligible species beyond 250 m could raise the priority only if it was recorded there, and the hint already covers all rings.
NT status is a lower extinction risk than threatened status, and it counts only through the three-species rule.
not_established: That the NT species currently occupy the stand to be felled.
That the site has no threatened species: absence of records is not absence of species.
next_action: Have a reviewer examine the 2026 NT fungus and lichen records, two of which fall within the polygon, and decide whether a field check for dead-wood and old-forest habitat is needed before felling starts.
